title: devclaw project manifest (devclaw.json)
description: Human-owned, PR-reviewed per-project declaration read by devclaw through the project_manifest doorway. Devclaw never writes this file outside the reviewable onboard PR path.

$schema.description: Optional pointer at this schema for editor validation.

schemaVersion.description: Manifest schema version. A version newer than the running instance understands fails loudly ('instance too old'), never a partial parse.

boilerplateRevision.description: The devclaw boilerplate revision this repo was last brought up to. Compared by doctor against the instance's BOILERPLATE_REVISION constant; re-onboard migrates.

strictnessDefault.description: Per-project gate-strictness default. Precedence: explicit per-goal setting > this value > instance default ('trust'), resolved live at each goal-level read.

surface.description: Declared frontend surface kind for the browser-E2E gate. 'library' applies the library exemption without path heuristics; 'app' or absent keeps the default glob heuristics. Read at pre_run_sha for gate decisions.

verifyCmd.description: Project-default verify command. Precedence: planner action verify_cmd > goal verify_cmd > this value. Resolved at dispatch (pre-run).

stack.description: Declared stack markers (e.g. 'dotnet', 'angular'). Informational in schema v1.
